newsitem.title: FINLAND: MARTELA SEES IMPROVING PROFIT IN 1997.
newsitem.headline: MARTELA SEES IMPROVING PROFIT IN 1997.

text.p: Finnish office furniture maker Martela Oy said on Friday it expected earnings this year to improve over 1996.
"We expect better earnings in 1997 than the previous year," Martela said in a statement with its 1996 results.

The general economic outlook in its main markets was quite positive, it said. "Under these conditions demand for office furniture can be expected to show some growth and group earnings can be expected to improve," Martela said.
Last year, Martela's pre-tax profit fell to 26 million markka from 50 million. --Helsinki Newsroom +358-9-680 50 245
